Holder Winslow Capital Management LLC Increased Expedia INC (EXPE) Position
May 26, 2018 - By Michael Collier
Investors sentiment decreased to 1.06 in 2017 Q4. Its down 0.37, from 1.43 in 2017Q3. It worsened, as 80 investors sold EXPE shares while 162 reduced holdings. 85 funds opened positions while 172 raised stakes. 118.55 million shares or 4.89% less from 124.65 million shares in 2017Q3 were reported. Putnam Invs Limited Com has 151,420 shares. Baltimore holds 0.32% or 12,638 shares. Ny State Teachers Retirement System reported 177,505 shares. Bluestein R H & Com holds 0.02% in Expedia Group, Inc. (NASDAQ:EXPE) or 2,500 shares. 8,901 are held by Butensky & Cohen Fincl Security. Utah Retirement has invested 0.06% of its portfolio in Expedia Group, Inc. (NASDAQ:EXPE). 168,794 are owned by State Board Of Administration Of Florida Retirement System. Louisiana State Employees Retirement Sys has 0.04% invested in Expedia Group, Inc. (NASDAQ:EXPE). Point72 Asset Lp reported 0.15% in Expedia Group, Inc. (NASDAQ:EXPE). Omega Advisors holds 0.88% in Expedia Group, Inc. (NASDAQ:EXPE) or 195,497 shares. Glenhill Advsrs Ltd Co has 0.28% invested in Expedia Group, Inc. (NASDAQ:EXPE) for 31,945 shares.
Winslow Capital Management Llc increased its stake in Expedia Inc (EXPE) by 20.96% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Winslow Capital Management Llc bought 535,874 shares as the company’s stock declined 12.14% with the market. The institutional investor held 3.09 million shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $370.41 million, up from 2.56 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Winslow Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Expedia Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $17.69B market cap company. The stock increased 0.72% or $0.84 during the last trading session, reaching $117.83. About 871,289 shares traded. Expedia Group, Inc. (NASDAQ:EXPE) has declined 17.38% since May 26, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 28.93% the S&P500.
Winslow Capital Management Llc, which manages about $33.78 billion and $18.10 billion US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Raytheon Co (NYSE:RTN) by 106,984 shares to 1.20M shares, valued at $225.80 million in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Netflix Inc (NASDAQ:NFLX) by 84,153 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 951,864 shares, and cut its stake in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL).
